description: This file defines authentication-related API routes for a FastAPI web application, including signup, login, current user retrieval, and logout functionalities.

classes.name: User
classes.description: A SQLAlchemy model representing a user in the database.

methods.name: TokenResponse signup(payload: SignupRequest, session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db_session)])
methods.description: Handles user registration, creating a new user and returning a JWT token.

methods.name: TokenResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db_session)])
methods.description: Handles user authentication, verifying credentials, and returning a JWT token.

methods.name: MeResponse me(current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)])
methods.description: Returns information about the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: ApiMessage logout(_: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)])
methods.description: Implements a logout endpoint that instructs the client to discard its JWT token.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^async def login(payload: LoginRequest, session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db_session)]/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^async def signup(payload: SignupRequest, session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db_session/
